items.label: New Configuration
items.value: The 10.1-inch tablet with the latest Android 14 system and a 2.0 GHz octa-core processor significantly boosts multitasking performance and operating speed for smoother operation

items.label: Performance Boost
items.value: Android tablet with 128GB ROM + 22GB (6+16) RAM, supports up to 1TB expansion. Compatible with apps like Netflix, Facebook, YouTube, and Widevine L1 certified, effortlessly running games, multimedia, and office software

items.label: Battery Upgrade
items.value: Dghrti tablet with an 8000mAh high-capacity battery delivers up to 8 hours of video playback or 5 hours of gaming, providing extended entertainment and browsing time

items.label: Elegant Design
items.value: Straight-edged profile with starlight cameras (5MP + 8MP), featuring a comfortable metal body. Equipped with a 1280x800 ultra-clear LCD display that effectively filters harmful blue light, reducing eye strain and protecting vision

items.label: Portable and Practical
items.value: Our tablet comes standard with keyboard, mouse, and other accessories, transforming into a simple laptop to effortlessly meet indoor work/study or outdoor entertainment needs

items.label: Built-in Media
items.value: A 10.1-inch Tablet, A Plastic Protective Film and a User's Manual, A US Power Adapter and Type-C Data Cable, A wireless mouse and a Bluetooth keyboard, Protective Case
